subject.title: Image tool fails to resolve media:// protocol paths for inbound Discord media

question: Should maintainers require a live Discord DM media reproduction before any code repair is queued for this resolver miss?
rationale: Current source and v2026.6.11 already cover the generic media-store URI path, so automation cannot safely choose between Discord handoff, state-root, and cleanup-lifetime fixes without live proof or targeted runtime logs.

options.title: Require live Discord proof
options.body: Keep this issue open for a live Discord DM attachment run that captures the saved path, emitted URI, active state dir, and image-tool result before selecting a repair.

options.title: Queue an exploratory regression
options.body: Allow a narrow repair attempt to add a Discord media lifecycle regression first, stopping if the current failure cannot be reproduced from source.

options.title: Close as generic fix covered
options.body: Treat PR 87101 as sufficient and close despite the later Discord-specific resolver miss remaining unverified.

recommendation.title: Require live Discord proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a live Discord DM attachment run that captures the saved path, emitted URI, active state dir, and image-tool result before selecting a repair.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest provenance for the current managed-media URI behavior is the merged PR 87101 media-reference work.
